How long does it normally take to ship and send a tracking number?
For ready-to-ship pieces, standard order processing takes 3–5 business days before a tracking number is generated and sent. Once processed, domestic shipping transit times vary by option, such as 2–3 business days for Express or 1–2 business days for Rush shipping.
If your item is made-to-order, custom, or personalized, production timelines vary: complimentary one-letter engravings take 5–7 business days, custom engravings take 10–15 business days, Dear Kaia nameplates take within 3 weeks, and general made-to-order pieces require roughly 4–6 weeks for production before shipping.
